div.p: DECA is a new type of digital entertainment studio that brings together the best of Hollywood, Madison Avenue, and Silicon Valley.

DECA is committed to creating the highest-quality entertainment for online audiences by combining premium video, social media, interactivity and community. DECA has evolved the traditional studio model through the creation of the first hybrid production and commercial model: DECA actively identifies, develops, finances, markets, and distributes interactive entertainment concepts and properties across the Internet, as well as other emerging digital technologies and platforms.
Deca was founded in 2007 by experienced entertainment and Internet executives, Michael Wayne and Chris Kimble, and is based in Santa Monica.
